thesis: High-value project formation offers a focused market with value before network density.
role: Specify buyer, opportunity-room workflow and illustrative economics.

ideas.statement: The entry market needs repeated costly search, verifiable evidence, meaningful invitations and manageable risk; project formation balances these better than mass hiring or local services.
Opportunity rooms turn uploaded requirements into role gaps, evidence-backed candidates and reciprocal qualification before focused meetings; invitations work through email or agents.
The vertical product should contain portable identity, authority, evidence and cross-provider primitives for later expansion.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Illustrative subscriptions and ARR scenarios test bottom-up viability rather than asserting global market capture.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: These operating numbers are scenarios, not forecasts; unrestrained outreach would poison trust.

audit.notes: Complete batch read; headings and navigation excluded from idea ranking.
